AND ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR place LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR color LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND boardType = #{boardType}

AND done = 0

AND color LIKE CONCAT('%', #{color}, '%')
AND place LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{place}, '%')
AND eventDate = #{eventDate}
AND eventDate >= #{startDate}
AND eventDate <= #{endDate}
ORDER BY eventDate DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
